dispositions.scope: Structural heading triage + bounded ambiguity classifier
dispositions.reason: The mandated architecture (deterministic triage into CONFIDENT_HEADING/CONFIDENT_PROSE_REFERENCE/AMBIGUOUS, with a bounded, source-only, fail-closed classifier for AMBIGUOUS candidates only) was built, and - after an internal process correction (the first wiring attempt targeted the wrong, explicitly-quarantined orchestrator file; caught within this same phase and fixed) - genuinely wired into the real live production entry point (lib/contract-model/analysis/orchestrator.ts's runContractAnalysis). An independent Part B auditor traced the call chain themselves (not trusting the implementers' report), confirmed the wiring holds, and ran 38 fresh adversarial cases spanning every required true-heading and prose-reference shape plus dedicated rank-stack composition checks: zero false accepts, zero false rejects, zero material hierarchy corruption. Confident documents cost zero classifier calls.

The mandated universal invariant (a shared helper every CURRENT_OPERATIVE_EVIDENCE-declared tool's execute() must call) was built and genuinely closes the originally-reported getOperativeProvision exploit for an already-effective conflict. The registry audit's count (7 CURRENT_OPERATIVE_EVIDENCE tools) was independently re-derived and confirmed correct, and 3 of 7 tools (getOperativeProvision, getDefinition, getRelatedAmendments) are genuinely safe in every case tested. But 4 of 7 tools (getParentClause, getChildren, getSiblingClauses, getReferencedProvision) share an identical, precisely root-caused residual gap: resolveNodeWithSupersessionAwareness (and getChildren's parity check) only consults the real operative status when view.currentText is non-null, but buildProvisionView always nulls currentText for exactly the CONFLICTED/unresolved cases this invariant must catch - so these 4 tools silently fall back to a raw per-node check that defaults to CURRENT_OPERATIVE whenever no effect has yet actually applied (a real-world 'signed but not-yet-effective' conflict shape, distinct from the already-effective shape the original fix covered). A real end-to-end exploit via getSiblingClauses reaches a persisted SemanticTruthRecord.trustStatus of VERIFIED off a genuinely conflicted section.
dispositions.recommendedFix: Make resolveNodeWithSupersessionAwareness and getChildren's equivalent check consult view.status directly and unconditionally whenever a real OperativeProvisionView exists for the node's section, mirroring how getOperativeProvision/getDefinition/getRelatedAmendments already do it - never branching on whether currentText happens to be non-null. Not applied in this phase per the production freeze and the governing spec's explicit stop rule.
